name: Wedding Preparation
summary: 婚礼准备发生在Capulet家，Capulet夫妇与Nurse为婚宴忙碌，体现家庭内部的分工与协作[1][2][3][4]。

sections.title: 准备地点
sections.text: 婚礼准备在Capulet's house进行，具体场景是第四幕第四场的Capulet家大厅[1]。这一地点表明婚礼由Capulet家族操办，属于家庭内部事务。

sections.title: 参与人物
sections.text: Lord Capulet催促众人起身，吩咐Angelica照看烤肉，并强调不要节省花费[2]。Lady Capulet把钥匙交给Nurse，让她去取更多香料[3]。Nurse则被派去处理糕点房要的枣子和榅桲[4]。三人各司其职，共同为婚礼做准备。

sections.title: 分工协作
sections.text: Lord Capulet负责统筹和催促，关注烤肉与开销[2]；Lady Capulet掌管钥匙和香料[3]；Nurse负责传递糕点房的需求[4]。这些原文显示婚礼准备中，主人与仆人之间有明确的任务分配。

citations.relation: Wedding Preparation 发生于 Capulet's house
Lord Capulet 参与 Wedding Preparation
citations.evidence_text: Come, stir, stir, stir! The second cock hath crow’d, The curfew bell hath rung, ’tis three o’clock. Look to the bak’d meats, good Angelica; Spare not for cost.

citations.relation: Lady Capulet 参与 Wedding Preparation
citations.evidence_text: Hold, take these keys and fetch more spices, Nurse.
They call for dates and quinces in the pastry.
